description: This Java source file defines the VisitEditor class, a property editor for the Visit entity in the OpenMRS project. It extends a generic OpenmrsPropertyEditor for converting between Visit objects and their string identifiers (IDs and UUIDs).

classes.name: VisitEditor
classes.description: A property editor class for the Visit entity, enabling conversion from string IDs or UUIDs to Visit objects within the OpenMRS framework.

methods.name: getObjectById
methods.description: Retrieves a Visit object based on its integer ID using the VisitService.

methods.name: getObjectByUuid
methods.description: Retrieves a Visit object based on its UUID string using the VisitService.
